options.text: Can you see your own rift?

steps.player: Can you see your own rift?

steps.npc: No. From time to time I feel it shift and change inside me though. It is an odd feeling.

options.text: Where would you like to go today, Rifty?

steps.player: Where would you like me to take you today Rifty?

steps.npc: Please do not call me that... we are a species of honour, [player name].

steps.player: Not the best guardian it seems.

steps.text: If the Rift guardian is set to changing colours upon binding essence at an altar:

steps.npc: If you take me to a Runecrafting Altar, I will adopt the altar's colour as you bind essence there.

options.text: I want you to stay this colour instead.

steps.player: I want you to stay this colour instead.

steps.npc: Very well, I will remain locked to this colour, even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.

options.text: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.

steps.player: Okay, carry on adopting the colour of altars.

steps.npc: Very well, I will adopt the altar's colour next time you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar.

steps.text: If the Rift guardian is set to keeping its colour upon binding essence at an altar:

steps.npc: Even if you bind essence at a Runecrafting Altar, I will remain locked to this colour.

options.text: I'd like you to adopt the altar's colour next time.

options.text: Okay, please stay locked to this colour.

The power of the Abyss grows. I fear for what will happen if our defence against it fails.

steps.player: The Guardians of the Rift have things under control. You don't need to worry.

steps.npc: Let us hope you are correct.

I'll convert your very essence into runes.
